outcome: Association between thyroid hormone levels and transient tachypnea of the newborn (TTN)
cohort: Neonates admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) due to TTN and healthy neonates followed up in the well-baby nursery
finding: The study found that infants admitted to NICU due to TTN had significantly different thyroid hormone levels compared to healthy infants, with differences depending on gestational age.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery did not have an effect on NICU admission for TTN.
gest_age: Late-preterm (34-36(6) weeks), early-term (37-38(6) weeks), and term (39-41(6) weeks)
